revisionBinding: Use the exact PR head / containing Git commit delivered with this manifest. Per-file SHA256 values identify the eight additive native sources; never install from an unpinned branch tip.
hashNormalization: SHA256 over UTF-8 without BOM, with CRLF normalized to LF; preserve all other bytes and the final newline. This permits normal Windows Git checkout line endings.

nativeBounds.backendDecodeAuthority: Existing app validates dimension/pixel budgets (4096 per dimension, 12M pixels/image, 24M pixels/batch), decodes formats and cleans partial conversion output.
nativeBounds.pdfValidationMeaning: Bounded content type/header/end-marker envelope checks only; structural/page/content validation is deferred.
nativeBounds.coverageLimit: A valid backend image is not guaranteed to produce an output under the native PDF cap. Oversize fails explicitly.

actionAndCleanup.uncertainSubmission: Freeze exact bytes/key. Retry or cancellation reconciliation uses the same action; do not substitute selected bytes or a new key.
actionAndCleanup.jobDeletion: Within a live session, reset key/selection after confirmed job deletion; the photo service releases deleted keys. Confirmed session revocation or authorization loss clears local state; shutdown abandons state without claiming remote deletion.
actionAndCleanup.disconnect: Explicit session DELETE; unconfirmed cleanup remains visible and does not become a success receipt.
actionAndCleanup.lifecycleClose: Clear masked input, invalidate panel generation and abort active transport; request bounded best-effort session revoke. Late output cannot open an export dialog in another panel generation.
actionAndCleanup.lostSessionCreationReceipt: Without the returned session capability the native client cannot confirm revoke; existing app expiry/retention is authoritative.
actionAndCleanup.localExport: Explicit new local PDF target. Retained validated ancestor handles and checked local volume paths reject reparse/network aliases. Bounded sibling write, failure disposition and non-replacing rename use the still-owned temporary handle. Existing images/documents are not overwritten; exported user files remain after job deletion.
